# Coda Café

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Specialty coffee roaster in Uruguay that roasts in small batches and sells online on Shopify. Sells whole-bean and ground coffee from several origins, and a gift box. States shipping across Uruguay; interior shipping cost is not shown on the homepage.
